d: This episode of Tarikh explores the extraordinary life of renowned Urdu poet Jaun Elia, a man whose brilliance was inseparable from his pain. From his childhood in Amroha and the trauma of Partition to his unfulfilled romances, turbulent marriage, and lifelong struggle with loneliness, the episode traces the journey of one of South Asia’s most celebrated literary voices. Through rare anecdotes, unforgettable poetry, and deeply personal stories, it reveals the contradictions that defined Elia: philosopher and rebel, lover and skeptic, wit and melancholic soul. A moving portrait of a poet…
